prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite atlas for a 2D chibi Three Kingdoms game. young heroic brown spiky ponytail, red scarf, bronze armor, clean shaven, brown horse, mounted on a small cute horse. Reference 1 is character identity (except enemy: use generic red officer); last reference is scale/style of mounted chibi sprites. Draw ONE character identity repeated in exactly 32 animation cells, 4 columns by 8 rows, portrait sheet 1:2 aspect ratio. Equal SQUARE cells, no labels, no grid lines. Every frame full rider AND full horse, facing RIGHT in same side/three-quarter view. Generous 12% transparent margin around each cell, identical size and ground baseline throughout. TRUE transparent alpha background, no magenta or checker pattern. Frame order row-major: first 8 frames (rows 1-2) mounted COMMAND: horse stands still on four feet, rider lifts commanding hand/baton, points firmly forward, lowers hand smoothly; frames 9-16 (rows 3-4) mounted CHEER once: horse stays on ground, rider smiles raises arm overhead triumphantly then lowers it; frames 17-32 (rows 5-8) mounted MOVE seamless 16-frame canter cycle, hooves alternate extension/tuck/landing with subtle body motion, start and end connect. The horse must not run in first four rows. Character anatomy, costume, horse coat and size must stay identical throughout. Bold clean dark outlines, rounded super-deformed proportions, high quality hand drawn cel shading like supplied references, clearly readable at 130px on battlefield. No effects, dust, scene, lettering or cast shadow.
